Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Jacob Mann (E027)
Requested: write access to Source Code

Facts:
- Role: Engineer
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (not advanced)

Policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

For contractor Jacob Mann: read, or write if advanced security training. He has basic training, so max is read.

Requested write > max read, so grant max = read.

Decision: read.
